Modern.brandNameRationale: Warp and weft are the two foundational thread structures of any woven textile — the longitudinal warp threads and the lateral weft threads. Paired with an ampersand they ground the brand entirely in weaving vocabulary. Note: this brand sits in the carpet-and-rug category; the same two-word structure has been used as a textile reference elsewhere, but Warp & Weft as a carpet brand is distinct.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern carpets and rugs have split between mass-import production and a small considered-handweave cohort. The opening is for a brand that puts the warp-and-weft structure in the brand position and builds a small permanent catalog of flatweaves and pile rugs.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Armadillo (armadillo-co.com) holds the considered-modern handweave slot. Nordic Knots (nordicknots.com) sits in the design-led DTC tier. Beni Rugs (benirugs.com) plays the Moroccan-handweave peer. We sit closer to Armadillo with a sharper structural-honesty framing.
Modern.positioningStatement: A modern carpet brand organized around the visible structure of the weave.

targetAudience.primary: 32 to 55. Owns one home. Knows the difference between flatweave and pile. Buys one rug every three years.
behaviors: Studies the back of the rug as carefully as the front
Will wait six months for the right size

dos: Show the back of the rug
Name the wool and the weaver
Quote the knot count per square inch

Modern.logoDirection: A wordmark — Warp & Weft set in a clean modern grotesk, with a small two-direction thread mark beside the word. The mark alone is the favicon.

typography.primary: GT America for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: GT America Mono for knot counts and dimensions
typography.rationale: One family. Mono carries the technical weave data.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: The Hammersmith rugs were William Morris's hand-knotted carpet line, woven at Merton Abbey from 1881 — the foundational Arts & Crafts response to industrial carpet manufacture. The line is historic and public-domain (the William Morris Society holds adjacent marks but not the Hammersmith Rug name). The definite article positions the brand as the singular reference.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury carpets at the hand-knotted Arts & Crafts tier serve the collector who commissions a single rug for a specific room. The product is one rug per commission, finished by hand, signed by the weaver.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Christopher Farr (christopherfarr.com) holds the considered-Arts-and-Crafts slot. Doris Leslie Blau (dorisleslieblau.com) is the antique-rug peer. The Rug Company (therugcompany.com) plays the designer-commissioned peer. We sit between Christopher Farr and Doris Leslie Blau with a sharper Hammersmith-tradition framing.
Luxury.positioningStatement: Hand-knotted carpets in the Hammersmith Rugs tradition of William Morris.

targetAudience.primary: 55 to 80. Multi-generational collector. Owns at least one Morris-tradition textile. Commissions a single rug for a specific room.
behaviors: Travels to the workshop for the dye visit
Pays in three installments over eighteen months

dos: Name the dye plant and the weaver
Speak in the language of madder and weld

Luxury.logoDirection: A serif wordmark — The Hammersmith Rug set in a classical roman with a small embossed mark of a Morris-tradition pattern. The mark appears on the back of every rug and on the printed commission certificate.

typography.primary: Canela for the wordmark and certificates
typography.secondary: Adobe Garamond for body and commission documents
typography.rationale: Canela carries the Arts & Crafts display tradition. Garamond keeps documentation warm.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: A knot is the unit of construction in a hand-knotted carpet — the single tied loop on the warp. Single trade word, single syllable, terminal period. The brand is the unit.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal carpet brands have converged on the same neutral palette. The opening underneath is a hand-knot rug brand stripped to the unit itself — the knot — with a small permanent catalog of plain undyed rugs.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Armadillo (armadillo-co.com) holds the considered-modern handweave peer slot. Nani Marquina (nanimarquina.com) sits in the considered-Spanish peer position. The Citizenry (the-citizenry.com) plays the considered-modern peer. We sit closer to Nani Marquina with a sharper single-unit focus.
Minimal.positioningStatement: Hand-knot rugs in undyed wool, sold by the knot count.

targetAudience.primary: 30 to 55. Owns a small home. Studies the back of the rug. Will wait nine months for the right size.
behaviors: Measures the room three times before ordering
Studies the knot count, not the pattern
Buys one rug every five years

dos: Show the knot count on the page
Name the wool and the weaver
Quote the knots per square inch
donts: Use the word minimal as marketing

Minimal.logoDirection: A wordmark only — Knot. set in a calm humanist sans, lowercase, terminal period. A small drawn knot mark serves as the favicon.

typography.primary: Neue Haas Grotesk for the wordmark and body
typography.rationale: One face. The brand is the knot, not the type.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: Senneh (the Persian asymmetric knot) and Ghiordes (the Turkish symmetric knot) are the two foundational knot constructions of hand-knotted carpets — public-domain technique names from the trade. Paired with Rug Co., the name reads as an established hand-knot rug importer and trade supplier.
Corporate.industrySummary: Hand-knotted carpet importing is a serious B2B category. The buyers are interior design firms, hospitality procurement, and high-end retail. The vendors compete on knot-count specification, lead time, and dye-lot consistency.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: Stark Carpet (starkcarpet.com) is the institutional designer-trade benchmark. Tufenkian (tufenkian.com) holds the considered-handknot slot. Bunny Williams Home (bunnywilliamshome.com) plays the designer-retail peer. We sit smaller, sharper on the knot-construction specification.
Corporate.positioningStatement: Hand-knotted carpet importing for the trade — Senneh and Ghiordes constructions specified by knot count.

targetAudience.primary: 45 to 60. Interior designers, hospitality procurement managers, and high-end retail buyers.
behaviors: Specifies by knot count and pile height
Requests sample swatches before the order

dos: Show sample swatches in raking light
Quote lead times to the week

Corporate.logoDirection: A wordmark with a small geometric mark — a stylized Senneh-and-Ghiordes knot comparison. SENNEH & GHIORDES RUG CO. set in a tight modern grotesk, suitable for B2B spec sheets and showroom signage.

typography.primary: Inter for marketing and B2B materials
typography.secondary: Source Serif Pro for printed spec books and RFPs
typography.rationale: Inter scales clean across digital. The serif handles printed trade documentation.

Creative.brandNameRationale: The medallion is the central motif of the classical Persian carpet — the perfectly symmetrical anchor that organizes the whole field. The Lopsided Medallion is the wabi-sabi inversion: the medallion that's slightly off-center, the carpet with character. The brand sits on the imperfection.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative carpet brands have crowded the maximalist-pattern space. The opening is for a brand that celebrates the slight asymmetry of the hand-woven medallion — the rug that wasn't ruled by a CAD file.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Beni Rugs (benirugs.com) holds the Moroccan-handweave slot. Cold Picnic (coldpicnic.com) sits in the considered-modern peer position. Pampa (pampa.com.au) plays the considered-creative peer. We sit closer to Pampa with a sharper imperfection framing.
Creative.positioningStatement: A creative carpet brand built on the slight asymmetry of the hand-woven medallion.

targetAudience.primary: 30 to 50. Buys one rug every two years. Reads about Persian and Moroccan traditions. Wants character, not perfection.
behaviors: Re-orders the same dye lot for a second room

dos: Show the off-center on the page
Name the weaver and the village
donts: Use the word boho as marketing
Photoshop the medallion back to center

Creative.logoDirection: A wordmark — The Lopsided Medallion set in a warm humanist serif with a small drawn mark of an off-center medallion. The medallion alone is the favicon.

typography.primary: GT Sectra for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: GT America for body and product descriptions
typography.rationale: Sectra carries the warmth. America handles the technical weave data.
